flags: OHV (drop candidate under the brief's rule, for review): the operator's About Us lists 'ATV trail access' among the features, and its rules regulate ATV and side-by-side operators in the campground. It is a general 93-site municipal campground, not an OHV staging area; the reviewer may prefer a caveat.

Long-stay check: 25 of the 92 listed sites are 'Seasonal' (awarded by a 2027 seasonal application drawing); 61 electric sites plus site 49 and two group sites are reservable nightly. A real public campground, not a seasonal-lease park.

Waterfront: keep lakefront. The operator prices 'With Electric and Lake access $40' (32 reservable + 17 seasonal sites at that rate) and says 'many of which are located on lakeshore'; on imagery campers sit on spurs at the shore of the peninsula's southern lobe and west side.
